marks.gloss_en: 15 Nisan a Thursday, so Rosh Chodesh Iyar was Shabbat and Rosh Chodesh Sivan Sunday -- against the Rabbanan
the baraita: in the Nisan of the Exodus they slaughtered on the 14th, left on the 15th, the firstborn were struck [the stam emends לערב to מבערב: the eve before], and that day was Thursday
אמרי לך רבנן: אייר דההיא שתא עבורי עברוה (= p_iyar_meubar)
ת"ש דלא עברוה: the baraita says Iyar was deficient and Sivan fell on Sunday -- קשיא לרבנן
[the Rabbanan:] Iyar of that year was made full [thirty days]
הא מני -- רבי יוסי היא (= p_bar_chaser_iyar_kery)
the baraita: Nisan was full and Iyar fell on Shabbat; Iyar was deficient and Sivan fell on Sunday
15 Iyar was Shabbat, so Rosh Chodesh Sivan was Sunday -- קשיא לרבנן
אמרי לך רבנן: אייר דההיא שתא עבורי עברוה (= p_iyar_meubar)

Rav Pappa: they came [to the wilderness of Sin] on the 15th of the second month (Ex 16:1), and that day was Shabbat -- 'in the morning you shall see the glory of the Lord' (16:7) and 'six days you shall gather it' (16:26)
1 Nisan of the second year was Sunday (the ten crowns, p_eser_atarot), so the year before it was Wednesday (Acherim's four days); then Iyar began Friday and Sivan Shabbat -- קשיא לרבי יוסי (Sunday)
לרבי יוסי שבעה חסרין עבוד -- that year seven months were made deficient
the same computation puts Rosh Chodesh Sivan on Shabbat -- קשיא לרבנן (Monday)
Acherim: between one Atzeret and the next, and one Rosh HaShana and the next, there are only four days [of the week]; in a leap year, five
Rava: [for the Rabbanan] the sixth -- of their encampment

the tanna: the day the Mishkan was raised (1 Nisan, Ex 40:17) took ten crowns -- first of the Creation [Sunday], first for the princes, the priesthood, the service, the descent of fire, the eating of sacred food, the dwelling of the Shechina, the blessing of Israel, the ban on private altars, and first of the months
